_note: One entry per provider and model. Model ids come from the owner's ranking and must be checked against each provider's list-models endpoint (pnpm llm:models). Limits stay null until filled from the provider's official page or observed in its response headers; in record or live mode the loader refuses to run while rpm or rpd is null. verified is true only when the numbers were read from an official page for the plan in use, or observed in the provider's own rate-limit headers for this account.

gemini-3.8-flash.note: limits read from the owner's Google AI Studio 'Gemini API Rate Limit' page (Free tier, project Default Gemini Project) on 2026-10-14: 5 RPM, 250K TPM (input tokens per minute), 20 RPD. The page counts input tokens only for TPM.

gemini-2.5-flash.note: Limits estimated from Google AI Studio free tier; verify from the rate-limits page for the plan in use.

openai/gpt-oss-120b.note: numbers are from the 'Free Plan Limits' table of https://console.groq.com/docs/rate-limits read 2026-10-14, whose text also says the table shows Developer-plan base limits: unconfirmed for the free plan until the response headers of a real call agree
